text:
Alex W: Quick draft runbook for "Soft Renewal Signals + Prefetch/Batching/Streaming" — can y'all scan?
Priya R: Skimmed, this is great. A couple of small asks on telemetry tags.
Jordan L: Can we add an onboarding_step tag and a last_successful_stream timestamp? Those help correlate churn.
Sam T: +1. Also add a renewal_risk boolean and a risk_reason enum for AE handoffs.
Alex W: Good call. I also put a short prefetch config example in the doc — open to better defaults.
Alex W: ```
# header-based examples for edge caches and runtime hints
X-Prefetch: enable=true;ttl=300
X-Batch-Mode: auto;max_latency_ms=50
X-Stream-Hint: keepalive=true;prefill=2
```
Priya R: For smaller accounts recommend ttl=900 when typical seq_len < 256, but for heavy token apps keep 300.
Jordan L: Suggest telemetry sample event to capture soft signals:
```
event: cs.renewal_signal
props: {onboard_pct: 0.67, failed_streams: 2, avg_latency_ms: 180, prefetch_hits: 12}
```
Sam T: For enablement coordination add a short AE checklist in the runbook:
- verify prefetch flags exist in prod headers
- run a 1:1 streaming validation with sample prompts
- confirm batch config doesn't violate latency SLOs
- attach last 3 feedback survey responses
Priya R: Also include template for the 7-day and 30-day feedback surveys (one closed, one freeform). We want consistent capture across CS reps.
Jordan L: I'll map survey fields back to telemetry (onboard_step, net_sentiment, noted_issues) so we can run weekly rollups.
Alex W: Adding a short escalation play for renewal-risk signals (>=2 failed_streams within 48h or net_sentiment < 0.2) with suggested outreach cadence.
Sam T: Add fallback guidance: when streaming degrades, switch to smaller model + aggressive batching, and mark customer with "reduced_streaming" flag.
Priya R: One more: include sample curl tests for customers so AE can reproduce quickly.
Alex W: Example curl I added:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Prefetch: enable=true;ttl=300' \
  -d '{"prompt":"test stream","stream":true}'
```
CS Bot: runbook-updated by Alex W (link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/softrenew-172555)
Alex W: Thanks everyone — I'll push updates to the onboarding repo and tag AE/ops. If no objections I'll merge EOD. :thumbsup:
Priya R: No objections from me.
Jordan L: Good to go from infra side.
Sam T: Go ahead. I'll prepare the short enablement slide for Monday.
